resources.string: Optional recovery on this server. Save the code separately. It resets your password and signs out all phones. It does not restore encrypted history or replace your administrator key. HTTPS is required.
Shown only now. Save this code in a safe place. Creating a new code immediately replaces the previous one. If the response is lost, create another code using your password.
Password changed. Sign in with your new password. This recovery code can no longer be used.
Could not complete recovery. Check your credentials, HTTPS connection and server version, or try again later. A lost response may mean the operation already completed.
